feeds.title: Peak Blog
feeds.description: Here we share our latest ideas on entrepreneurship and our events. We are an early-stage venture capital fund based in Amsterdam, Berlin, and Stockholm. We invest Europe-wide and have active investments in the Benelux, DACH, and Nordic regions. We are fully funded and run by experienced entrepreneurs.

feeds.title: Rude VC
feeds.description: Explore mark bivens' blog about venture capital, sumo, triathlon, and reggae. I am passionate about reggae music, sumo, and triathlons. For my day job, I pretend to be a VC with Shizen Capital in Tokyo.

feeds.title: AXA Venture Partners News
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on our investments, market news and insights, and more! We invest in companies that leverage differentiated technologies and scalable business models to generate financial returns and drive innovation.

feeds.title: Spintop Ventures News
feeds.description: Spintop Ventures is an early-stage technology venture capital firm. We support teams on a mission to build great companies. Spintop invests in innovative software-based technology companies from the Nordics to become sector leaders and drive the transformation into a long-term sustainable society. Get our investment and portfolio news.

feeds.title: Yannick Oswald Blog
feeds.description: All you need to know about tech trends and early-stage startup funding in Europe by Yannick Oswald. My name is Yannick and I am an early-stage VC and Partner at Mangrove Capital Partners, and a Kauffman fellow, Class 23. I travel all around Europe to work with exceptional entrepreneurs and discover their unique insights.

feeds.title: Daphni

feeds.title: Sunstone Life Science Ventures
feeds.description: Find the Latest press releases - plus an archive of press releases, thus recording milestones and key facts in Sunstone's history. feeds.title: Mairdumont Ventures News

feeds.title: Acton Capital News

We invest with a clear focus on tech-enabled business models throughout Europe and North America - committed to sustainable growth.
